entries.reviewNotes: Read Japanese mismatched-account context and all twelve full target/hint sets; clarified account holder versus contracted company, known-number check, postponed unaccepted transfer, form return and corrected Chinese recipient hints.

Read Japanese guitar-packing context and all twelve complete target/hint sets; clarified shipping parcel, outer rigid box/cushioning, instrument movement, separately secured tools, repacking/fee check and photo before lid closure.
